ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution featuring a dominant high-intensity white central field (approx. 80-85%) bordered by low-intensity black margins and a central dark basal patch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and outer margins. A large, irregular dark anchor-shaped patch is located at the peduncle junction. Minor dark mottling is present surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined U-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45-55 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; peaks show irregular pixel-amplitude, most pronounced on the upper-left and upper-right lobe segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve extending from the central notch to the distal tips, forming a characteristic wide-V symmetrical lobe geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the left ventral lobe, cutting across the white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; visible tooth rake marks on the left lobe surface; jagged dark pigmentation boundary at the fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: The central dark basal patch exhibits a jagged, flame-like pixel boundary where it meets the white fluke interior.
